observed.delivery: Static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no package build.
observed.assets: Vendored fonts, Font Awesome 6.7.2, placeholder images, favicon set, and social image.
observed.responsive: Desktop CSS plus tablet breakpoints at 1199 and 1056 pixels and mobile breakpoints at 767 and 479 pixels.
observed.accessibility: Semantic main, sections, headings, image alt text, button-based mobile toggle, and native details; the toggle does not expose expanded state and no reduced-motion rule was observed.
observed.javascript: Imperative mobile navigation plus optional pricing toggle; static content otherwise requires no JavaScript.
observed.customization: Content, images, and CSS variables; light and dark theme classes are documented.

adapted: wide hero and product proof rhythm
not_copied: Inter and JetBrains Mono font files
placeholder images, client logos, favicon files, and social image
divergences: React sections are typed and driven by one manifest content object.
The React/Vite foundation remains the base pack and LaunchKit is only an ordered overlay.
Identity semantic tokens and asset URLs replace local brand edits and vendored template assets.
Responsive navigation wraps without an imperative menu controller.
Full landing content is pre-rendered and then progressively hydrated.
Reduced motion, focus visibility, performance budgets, deterministic builds, and link checks are executable gates.
Agent-Ready Web and policy routes remain composition slots owned by their open contracts.
